newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador to launch new economic plan Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador to launch new economic plan Wednesday.

text.p: Ecuador plans to launch its new economic plan next Wednesday, Vice-President Rosalia Arteaga said Friday.
"The president has given us that deadline to present the new economic and social plan," she told foreign reporters.

Arteaga said the government hopes to be able to specify by the end of the year how much revenue it will earmark for social policy. On Thursday, however, she told reporters the social plan had a budget of $250 million which would be announced Wednesday.

Arteaga said the government was firmly committed to carrying out the new social plan, which will focus on housing, education and nutrition, and would try to make economic and social policies compatible.
"I have pledged to fight for funds for the social sector, and I will insist upon this in the cabinet," she said.
Half of Ecuador's population of 11.4 million lives below the poverty line.
President Abdala Bucaram, who took office one month ago, promised during the electoral campaign to build 200,000 homes during his four-year administration.
